decision: Do not treat the current contract as sufficient for production classification. Preserve unresolved rows and expand deterministic rules from observed source structures before Phase 2 full-ledger output.
observedGaps: Many valid source types omit the mv.object. prefix, including location-node, rules-profile, region-definition, faction-definition, environment-definition, location-archetype-definition, settlement-definition, and setting-culture-definition.
Many canonical records carry stable mv.* identities but no explicit object type.
Workbook sheet names and pack member paths provide strong domain evidence not yet represented in the contract.
Reference maps, ownership maps, source disposition registers, and capability maps require support-record rules distinct from primary assets.
safety: No payloads were deleted, merged, promoted, or rewritten during this dry run.
